title: The Workflow reconciler settles on every non-running state, including the contract's non-terminal pending/starting
body: The settle branch waits only on state === "running" (now inside decision D34's pinned region). job_status's non-terminal vocabulary also has pending and starting, which the current sandbox executor never emits; an executor that did would have its attempt collected before it began. Either wait on !terminal or record that the host's executors never emit those states.
